note:
Builds shorts_spec.json + the timing tables for SHORTS_PLAN.md from one beat list per Short.
Run: python3 -I gen_shorts.py <lines.py> <out_dir>
Durations are ESTIMATES from word counts (narrator 2.9 w/s, characters 2.6 w/s); the assembler must re-time every beat
from the real clip lengths in timeline.json (same order, same gaps) once the narration is back.

format.render: landscape design space 1920x1080 rendered at 3414x1920, 1080-px window cropped per shot (crop_cx in design px; window = 607.5 design px wide) or a native vertical camera if the engine gets one
format.loudness: -14 LUFS integrated, LRA <= 2.5 LU, true peak <= -1 dBTP

shorts.title: A Cop Knocks At 12:36 AM... The Man In His Car Is YOU
shorts.angle: The knock and the man in the back seat: a five-step identity match that ends with a stranger claiming your house in your voice.
shorts.hud: Top centre: doorbell-style clock "12:36 AM" (ticks per minute every beat), under it an ID-scan meter "MATCH 0%" that climbs 20/40/60/80/99/100 on each clue.

music.note: Track section 13.2-53.2 is the quiet build (-14..-18 LUFS); the 53.2 s boundary (loud, -9.4) must land on "It's yours." Slip the track start so it does. Alternate: a_massive_mist 0-68.7.

shorts.loop: The CTA ends on two knocks over black; a 8-frame REWIND glitch whips to frame 1, which opens on the same two knocks on the doorbell lens.

assembly_rules: Voice clips: cut each line from the English narration by timeline.json t/end (word slices by ASR word starts, 40 ms pre-roll, 60 ms tail, 5 ms fades). Keep the long video voice FX (radio/phone) on Y/M/O radio lines.

Re-time: place beats in order with the listed gap_after; shots keep their fraction of the beat. If the real total exceeds 56 s, first tighten gaps to 0.08 s (not the tension gap), then apply atempo up to 1.06 to narrator lines, then drop beats with fewest story duties (S1: L23; S2: L67; S3: L222). If under 48 s, lengthen the tension gap to 1.6 s and the end card to 2.5 s.
Every beat longer than 2.0 s gets an extra punch-in (110-125 %) or a cut at its middle so no frame is idle more than 0.8 s; target 35-50 hard cuts per Short.
Captions are word-synced from the ASR words (1-2 words per chunk); the caption_keywords get the accent colour and the punch.
Music runs 100 % of the time except the tension gap; duck 9 dB under the voice with 80 ms attack / 250 ms release; master -14 LUFS, LRA <= 2.5, TP <= -1 dBTP.
